test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LNH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b14713f04a12861d689e7679b03ccff1df62087be14414556358f8f74780ce1d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1fc1e2a22f90f6c04c5cb5b1efdfae53a370c4034c1311bb8daf36f1951fece.png] 

Option 2) GIC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33c53fdb2db2236ab959a1c2eb3c3d9c4e2d7529ccf7bbe1a5c62cba9c05c51b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90286731e697780c5c6a3efb40ac4891e3f5f93d770732d8eb831c71407607c3.png] 

Option 3) **EGB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ae04b3647b78d2dda4bc33cb4bf065550d510db3e545631ac5eaf43e106fd4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0efb67cb9778132ab171c23ddc39a418cd5bb1da9ffdbffcd18745393aff82fc.png] 

Option 4) IKE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259b6119cdb07d067633a369140e6408d931eb5cddaa192fecef238714e41b47.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba78db22649bf2cba9e8a964da22ba1abd73ab7da36a9dd35093fc56d27f5e7.png] 

Here, '**EGB'** is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
